newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CSFB sees Nestle 96 EPS rising 9.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: CSFB sees Nestle 96 EPS rising 9.1 pct.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston said it expected Nestle SA to announce on Wednesday that 1996 earnings per share rose 9.1 percent to 81.2 Swiss francs.
The median forecast in a survey of 23 analysts by Edinburgh Financial Publishing was for 1996 net profit to rise 10.5 percent to 3.23 billion Swiss francs. It put EPS at 82 francs, up from 74.4.
"We expect strong growth in 1997 at the sales, trading profit and EPS levels, mainly due to the appreciation of the dollar vis a vis the Swiss franc," analyst Anne Alexandre wrote.

"We don't expect however any margin improvement in 1997 after the slight decrease that we are forecasting for this year," she added. She put 1996 trading profit at 9.6 percent of sales, down from 9.7 percent in 1995.
